lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in three primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The mid-tier row contains the largest and most distinct local maxima with consistent spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a subtle grid-like lattice across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible portion of the pectoral fin in the lower quadrant exhibits a high concentration of small, high-luminance spots across its surface.
